page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3.xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz. The instance provides 4 vCPUs across 2 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, paired with 32.0 GB of system memory. It features 959 GB of bundled local SSD storage and a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps, running on the KVM hypervisor.

Benchmark data indicates that the processor and memory subsystem deliver modest performance. The stress-ng single-core and multi-core CPU metrics fall into the bottom 25%, as do the Passmark CPU and database operations scores. However, the system achieves average performance in Geekbench single-core testing and Passmark memory evaluations. Memory bandwidth for large block reads and writes is measured at 27.19 GB/sec and 23.19 GB/sec respectively, which also aligns with the lower quartile of tested instances.

From a resource density perspective, the ecs.i3.xlarge offers a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per core alongside substantial local SSD storage, presenting a qualitatively cost-efficient profile for workloads requiring local data caching or moderate memory capacity without demanding high-compute performance. Due to the lower CPU and multi-threaded decompression benchmarks, it is less suited for compute-intensive processing or high-throughput web serving. Appropriate workloads include memory-intensive caching, lightweight database operations, and general-purpose tasks requiring local SSD storage.
